meta.title: Pellmore Home returns and refunds
meta.description: A decision tree for customer service advisers at a homeware retailer: four questions decide whether a returned item gets a refund, a repair or replacement, store credit or nothing.

summary.headline: Faulty goods follow the law; change-of-mind returns follow our 28-day policy.
points: A fault reported within 30 days of delivery gets a full refund; the customer does not have to accept a repair.
After 30 days, offer one repair or replacement first; refund if that fails.
Personalised and perishable items cannot be returned for a change of mind.

data.title: Is the item faulty?
data.subtitle: Or not as described
data.description: Broken on arrival, stopped working in normal use, or different from the photos and description.

data.title: Full refund
data.subtitle: Including delivery costs
data.description: Short-term right to reject. We collect the item free and refund within 14 days of the collection.

data.title: Repair or replace
data.subtitle: One attempt, at our cost
data.description: If the repair or replacement fails, offer a refund, less a fair deduction for use after six months.

data.title: Decline the return
data.subtitle: Exempt from change of mind
data.description: Explain the exemption politely and point to the policy shown at checkout.

data.title: Refund the price
data.subtitle: Customer pays return postage
data.description: Refund to the original payment method within 14 days of receiving the item back.

data.title: Store credit at most
data.subtitle: Team leader decides
data.description: Outside the window or used: no right to a refund. A team leader may offer store credit for loyal customers.

steps.title: Overview
steps.description: Start at the top with the customer on the phone or in chat. The change-of-mind branch opens folded; the steps unfold it.

steps.title: Faulty goods
steps.description: A fault puts the customer's legal rights first. The only question is how long ago the item arrived.

steps.title: Refund or repair
steps.description: Within 30 days the customer can insist on a full refund. After that, offer one repair or replacement before a refund.

steps.title: Change of mind
steps.description: Nothing is wrong with the item. Personalised and perishable goods are exempt from change-of-mind returns.

steps.title: The 28-day window
steps.description: Unused and back within 28 days: refund the price. Otherwise there is no refund, though a team leader may offer store credit.
